summary: 68-foot Wisconsin stairway-style tower built 1932 near Camp Douglas; staffed to 2015, removed 2023; site lies on Volk Field Air National Guard Base.

facts.design: 68-foot Wisconsin standard stairway-style tower with internal dogleg stairs
facts.status_note: Removed in 2023 per both registers; no source describes what remains at the site

access.note: Site is listed inside Volk Field Air National Guard Base; no source describes public access

events.note: Four watch towers were being erected in the 11th district of the Wisconsin conservation commission's forest fire protection branch; Camp Douglas was one of the planned sites
NHLR 'Built' field and description give 1932; a May 1932 newspaper lists Camp Douglas as completed
Staffed intermittently during spring fire season until 2015, when Wisconsin decommissioned its lookout network
Both registers say the tower was removed in 2023

notes_for_editor: NHLR and the Former Fire Lookout Sites register agree on build year 1932, staffing to 2015, and removal in 2023. Brief lists agency as 'Conservation Department'; the Wisconsin lookouts page uses that wording for the district, while NHLR credits the Wisconsin Conservation Commission, so the record uses the commission. A DVIDS and Louisiana Guard item from July 2026 reports a new fire training tower built at Volk Field CRTC; no source ties it to the lookout site, so it is not mentioned. No photo URLs were captured; NHLR photo captions are not cited.
